exam_set.title: Practice Set 4
exam_set.description: Textbook Practice — Book 1, Chapter 11, Practice Set 4

questions.jp: リスクアセスメントを構成するプロセスの組合せはどれか。
questions.romaji: Risuku asesumento o kōsei suru purosesu no kumiawase wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which combination constitutes the risk assessment process?

options.label: ア
options.jp: リスク特定、リスク評価、リスク受容
options.romaji: Risuku tokutei, risuku hyōka, risuku juyō
options.en: Risk identification, evaluation, acceptance

options.label: イ
options.jp: リスク特定、リスク分析、リスク評価
options.romaji: Risuku tokutei, risuku bunseki, risuku hyōka
options.en: Risk identification, analysis, evaluation

options.label: ウ
options.jp: リスク分析、リスク対応、リスク受容
options.romaji: Risuku bunseki, risuku taiō, risuku juyō
options.en: Risk analysis, treatment, acceptance

options.label: エ
options.jp: リスク分析、リスク評価、リスク対応
options.romaji: Risuku bunseki, risuku hyōka, risuku taiō
options.en: Risk analysis, evaluation, treatment

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Find risks, understand them, then judge priority.

Technical breakdown:
Risk assessment comprises risk identification, risk analysis, and risk evaluation. Treatment and acceptance follow assessment decisions.

Japanese keywords to remember:
リスク特定 = risuku tokutei = risk identification
リスク分析 = risuku bunseki = risk analysis

Why the best solution works:
イ contains exactly the three assessment processes.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
Acceptance is a treatment decision, and analysis is missing.
ウ:
Identification and evaluation are missing; treatment/acceptance are later actions.
エ:
Identification is missing and treatment is outside assessment.

Memory trick:
Assess = identify, analyze, evaluate.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: リスク共有（リスク移転）に該当するものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Risuku kyōyū (risuku iten) ni gaitō suru mono wa dore ka.

options.label: ア
options.jp: 損失の発生率を低下させること
options.romaji: Sonshitsu no hasseiritsu o teika saseru koto
options.en: Reduce loss probability

options.label: イ
options.jp: 保険への加入などで、他者との間でリスクを分散すること
options.romaji: Hoken e no kanyū nado de, tasha to no aida de risuku o bunsan suru koto
options.en: Distribute risk to another party, such as through insurance

options.label: ウ
options.jp: リスクの原因を除去すること
options.romaji: Risuku no gen'in o jokyo suru koto
options.en: Remove the risk cause

options.label: エ
options.jp: リスクを扱いやすい単位に分解するか集約すること
options.romaji: Risuku o atsukaiyasui tan'i ni bunkai suru ka shūyaku suru koto
options.en: Split or aggregate risk into manageable units

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Insurance shares financial impact with insurer.

Technical breakdown:
Risk transfer shifts or shares consequences contractually with another party; insurance is canonical.

Japanese keywords to remember:
リスク移転 = risuku iten = risk transfer
保険への加入 = hoken e no kanyū = obtaining insurance

Why the best solution works:
イ explicitly transfers/distributes risk to another party.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
This is risk reduction.
ウ:
This is risk avoidance/removal.
エ:
Reorganizing risk units is not transfer.

Memory trick:
Insurance transfers impact.

Correct answer: イ

questions.romaji: BCP no setsumei wa dore ka.

options.label: ア
options.jp: 企業の戦略を実現するために、財務、顧客、内部ビジネスプロセス、学習と成長の視点から戦略を検討したもの
options.romaji: Kigyō no senryaku o jitsugen suru tame ni, zaimu, kokyaku, naibu bijinesu purosesu, gakushū to seichō no shiten kara senryaku o kentō shita mono
options.en: Examine strategy from financial, customer, process, and learning perspectives

options.label: イ
options.jp: 企業の目標を達成するために業務内容や業務の流れを可視化し、一定のサイクルをもって継続的に業務プロセスを改善するもの
options.romaji: Kigyō no mokuhyō o tassei suru tame ni gyōmu naiyō ya gyōmu no nagare o kashika shi, ittei no saikuru o motte keizokuteki ni gyōmu purosesu o kaizen suru mono
options.en: Visualize and continuously improve business processes

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 業務効率の向上、業務コストの削減を目的に、業務プロセスを対象としてアウトソースを実施するもの
options.romaji: Gyōmu kōritsu no kōjō, gyōmu kosuto no sakugen o mokuteki ni, gyōmu purosesu o taishō to shite autosōsu o jisshi suru mono
options.en: Outsource business processes for efficiency and cost reduction

options.label: エ
options.jp: 事業中断の原因とリスクを想定し、未然に回避又は被害を受けても速やかに回復できるように方針や行動手順を規定したもの
options.romaji: Jigyō chūdan no gen'in to risuku o sōtei shi, mizen ni kaihi mata wa higai o ukete mo sumiyaka ni kaifuku dekiru yō ni hōshin ya kōdō tejun o kitei shita mono
options.en: Define policy and procedures to avoid disruption or recover quickly

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
BCP keeps critical business running or restores it quickly after trouble.

Technical breakdown:
Business Continuity Planning anticipates disruption, establishes prevention, response, and recovery policies/procedures.

Japanese keywords to remember:
事業中断 = jigyō chūdan = business interruption
速やかに回復 = sumiyaka ni kaifuku = recover promptly

Why the best solution works:
エ states continuity and recovery planning.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
This is balanced scorecard thinking.
イ:
This is business process management/improvement.
ウ:
This is business process outsourcing.

Memory trick:
BCP = business continues after crisis.

Correct answer: エ

questions.jp: 情報の“完全性”を脅かす攻撃はどれか。
questions.romaji: Jōhō no 'kanzensei' o obiyakasu kōgeki wa dore ka.

options.label: ア
options.jp: Webページの改ざん
options.romaji: Web pēji no kaizan
options.en: Web-page tampering

options.label: イ
options.jp: システム内に保管されているデータの不正コピー
options.romaji: Shisutemu-nai ni hokan sarete iru dēta no fusei kopī
options.en: Unauthorized copying of stored data

options.label: ウ
options.jp: システムを過負荷状態にするDoS攻撃
options.romaji: Shisutemu o kafuka jōtai ni suru DoS kōgeki
options.en: DoS attack that overloads a system

options.label: エ
options.jp: 通信内容の盗聴
options.romaji: Tsūshin naiyō no tōchō
options.en: Eavesdropping on communications

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Integrity means information stays correct and unaltered. Tampering breaks it.

Technical breakdown:
Unauthorized modification of a Web page changes information, directly violating integrity. Copying and eavesdropping threaten confidentiality; DoS threatens availability.

Japanese keywords to remember:
完全性 = kanzensei = integrity
改ざん = kaizan = tampering

Why the best solution works:
ア is unauthorized alteration, the defining integrity threat.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ:
Unauthorized copying exposes information and threatens confidentiality.
ウ:
DoS prevents service use and threatens availability, not integrity.
エ:
Eavesdropping discloses information and threatens confidentiality.

Memory trick:
CIA: copy/listen = confidentiality; change = integrity; stop = availability.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: ISMS適合性評価制度の説明はどれか。
questions.romaji: ISMS tekigōsei hyōka seido no setsumei wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which describes the ISMS conformity assessment scheme?

options.label: ア
options.jp: ISO/IEC 15408に基づき、IT関連製品のセキュリティ機能の適切性・確実性を評価する。
options.romaji: ISO/IEC 15408 ni motozuki, IT kanren seihin no sekyuriti kinō no tekisetsusei, kakujitsusei o hyōka suru.
options.en: Evaluate IT product security under ISO/IEC 15408

options.label: イ
options.jp: JIS Q 15001に基づき、個人情報について適切な保護措置を講じる体制を整備している事業者などを認定する。
options.romaji: JIS Q 15001 ni motozuki, kojin jōhō ni tsuite tekisetsu na hogo sochi o kōjiru taisei o seibi shite iru jigyōsha nado o nintei suru.
options.en: Certify personal-information protection under JIS Q 15001

options.label: ウ
options.jp: JIS Q 27001に基づき、組織が構築した情報セキュリティマネジメントシステムの適合性を評価する。
options.romaji: JIS Q 27001 ni motozuki, soshiki ga kōchiku shita jōhō sekyuriti manejimento shisutemu no tekigōsei o hyōka suru.
options.en: Assess an organization's ISMS conformity under JIS Q 27001

options.label: エ
options.jp: 電子政府推奨暗号リストに基づき、暗号モジュールが適切に保護されていることを認証する。
options.romaji: Denshi seifu suishō angō risuto ni motozuki, angō mojūru ga tekisetsu ni hogo sarete iru koto o ninshō suru.
options.en: Certify cryptographic modules using the e-government cipher list

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
ISMS certification checks whether an organization's security management system meets its standard.

Technical breakdown:
JIS Q 27001 specifies ISMS requirements; conformity assessment evaluates the implemented management system.

Japanese keywords to remember:
適合性 = tekigōsei = conformity
情報セキュリティマネジメントシステム = jōhō sekyuriti manejimento shisutemu = ISMS

Why the best solution works:
ウ links ISMS evaluation to JIS Q 27001.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア:
This is Common Criteria product evaluation.
イ:
This concerns personal information protection management.
エ:
This concerns cryptographic-module certification.

Memory trick:
ISMS certification → ISO/JIS 27001.

Correct answer: ウ
